claude.add_connector_path: Customize > Connectors, then click the + next to Connectors and browse the directory (or from a chat: + > Connectors > Manage connectors > +). Then click Connect/Install and sign in. Some broker docs still say 'Settings > Connectors'; the current Anthropic path is Customize > Connectors.
claude.custom_connector_note: For a service not in the directory: Customize > Connectors > Add > Custom > Web, paste the server's remote MCP URL, then Connect and sign in in the browser. Custom connectors run from Anthropic's cloud, so never paste a remote URL into claude_desktop_config.json. Free plan: one custom connector. Local (stdio) servers such as tastytrade's need a developer-style setup.
claude.keep_awake_setting: Settings > This computer > System: turn on 'Keep computer awake' (the computer will not idle-sleep while Claude Desktop is open; closing a laptop lid still sleeps it) and 'Run on startup' (Claude Desktop opens at login). Claude Code docs also name the page 'Settings > Desktop app'. Known bugs: Windows 'Run on startup' may not stick; macOS keep-awake may also keep the display on.
claude.scheduled_tasks: Available on all paid plans (Pro, Max, Ultra, Team, Enterprise). Create: click Scheduled in the left sidebar > New task > Create with Claude or Set up manually (name, prompt, approval mode, frequency hourly/daily/weekdays/weekly/manual, optional model and folder), or just describe the task in a chat. A task with a local folder / 'Require this computer' (or 'Only on this computer') runs only while the computer is awake and Claude Desktop is open; tasks without a folder run remotely on schedule. Missed runs (local): when the app opens or the computer wakes, Desktop runs ONE catch-up for the most recent missed time and discards older ones (7-day window), so a 9am task can run at 11pm. Connector tools need a lasting approval ('Allow for all scheduled runs' in Cowork / 'Always allow' in Code) or the run stalls waiting for a click. Minimum interval is 1 hour in the forms. Open bug reports exist about dropped Cowork scheduled runs, so check the task's History page.
claude.per_tool_toggles: Yes, but documented for Team and Enterprise only: Customize > Connectors > select the connector > Tool permissions groups tools (read-only vs write/delete) and lets an Owner set each category or tool to Always allow, Needs approval or Blocked, org-wide. Anthropic's help article does not say whether individual Pro/Max users get the same panel; not confirmed. Safest default for a read-only coach: connect only read-only connectors, leave order-capable connectors disconnected, and keep approvals on 'Needs approval'.

items.name: Interactive Brokers

connector.notes: Anthropic verified, sign-in required, 10 tools, all get_/search_ names: balances, positions, summary, orders, trades, allocation, price history, snapshots, contract search, get_order_instructions. Claude can draft trade instructions that go to IBKR for your review; page says Claude never submits orders to the market. Read-only coaching works fine. Futures coverage of the connector not stated.

Click Run and save the file.

items.name: NinjaTrader / Tradovate

connector.name: NinjaTrader MCP (custom connector)
connector.notes: Official remote MCP server, available only to Tradovate and NinjaTrader users. Add as a custom connector: demo https://mcp-demo.tradovateapi.com/mcp (simulated money), live https://mcp-live.tradovateapi.com/mcp; OAuth in the browser. Has read tools (my_portfolio, order_history, fill_history, performance_summary) and write tools (place_order, risk settings) gated by access levels you approve. Start on Demo. Beta status not stated; listing in Claude's directory not found.

steps: Tradovate web app: Account Reports.
Choose Fills (or Orders / Position History / Performance), set dates and click GO.
Download as CSV.
export.format_notes: Fills = every filled order; Position History = entry/exit pairs; Performance includes the trade list. NinjaTrader 8 desktop (Windows only; on a Mac she uses the NinjaTrader/Tradovate web or desktop app): New > Trade Performance, switch to Trades or Executions, right-click > Export (forum-sourced, not an official help page). Default to ask for: Performance (matches the tradovate_performance preset).

items.notes: Most relevant path for a futures trader; grant read-only access during authorization.
